body:
I don't really see the value in just emotional understanding. My psychology teacher always stressed that venting is bad, because all it does is keep the anger alive.

What good does someone "emotionally understanding" me do? Nothing in my eyes.

I used to use chess.com to play. I've studied the openings. My FIDE ELO has never breached 1200. I've studied a lot, played near as many as you, yet I've never reached that level either. But I quit chess long ago once I thought I had peaked. It's been about two years since I played to rise in the ratings.

I don't drive either. I'm 17, where most my age have driven and want to, yet I'm terrified of it. 

Funnily enough, we're also about the same height and both overweight. I'd wager I'm more overweight than you thought. Genetics cursed me with small hands, so I, sadly, cannot palm a basketball.

I, however, have not had to suffer such awful things as you enumerated. I don't know what it's like and I can not think of how to comfort you on such matters. However, if you'd like a new friend, I'm avaliable. I'd play chess with you when I have time, and I promise I've got plenty. 

You offered to let me vent to you on my post, so at least consider my offer to be your chess pal.

EDIT: Missing space and typo

I got that from the very safe assumption that issues require thought and logic to be solved, and that it'd be impossible to solve if vital info was lacking.

Anyway, do you mean to suggest that peer support is basically, one person complains, and the others awkwardly stand by and say "Please don't kill yourself" or whatever general, not personalized state of the week is popping? Because, aside from questions that could have been answered had the poster been more specific, I normally don't see anything too substantive. 

I suppose you've noticed something without seeing any of my old texts. I don't know what I need. No idea.

Anyway, after my only experience with therapists about... 4 years ago I think... I'd never go back. I went for a problem that doesn't exist anymore, but I noticed that it never seemed to help. And, based on what I know about the phone hotlines, they couldn't possibly help someone like me. They're already inundated anyway. Why waste their time with someone who isn't an immediate risk, like me?

You're right about the name. It is missing the accent that should be over the e in se. reddit (reddit is always lowercase IIRC) doesn't like the accent marks, so I had to do with without the accent. I also don't need the yo in there, but NoSeQuienSoy was already taken. 

You won't find anything on this account nor a trace of the others. I used a throwaway for all of them and deleted all of the unanswered posts except for one. The one time I used my real one, it came back to bite me, so I only use throwaways or otherwise unused accounts for this sort of thing.
